economic_assumptions.price_basis: 2026 Indonesia proxy; not a national statistical average
economic_assumptions.price_policy: Editable assumptions; local quotation should replace these values for final TEA.
source_notes: Cement and sand baseline anchored to 2026 local-government price references and cross-checked against a 2026 national-market price range article; these are proxies, not a national statistical mean.
Industrial electricity baseline uses PLN/ESDM Q3 2026 I-3/TM tariff Rp1,114.74/kWh.
Labor baseline is an explicit 2026 model assumption informed by BPS construction wage data; it is not presented as an official national 2026 wage average.
Residue cost, transport, processing energy, equipment and admixture are scenario assumptions requiring local quotation or measurement.

input_contract.status_policy: FACTS MUST HAVE SOURCE_ID; SCENARIO VALUES ARE ASSUMPTIONS

notes: Paper cost model and the maturation pass explicitly identify the paving-block production line CAPEX as missing.

sensitivity.label_note: Low/high are scenario semantics, not numeric direction

sensitivity.direction: ↑ replacement → ↑ residue requirement / alters material cost

environmental_assumptions.factor_note: 0.85 kg CO2e/kg cement is a screening assumption aligned with the order of magnitude of published cement-emissions factors; replace with Indonesian/cement-specific verified LCA factor for final claim. World Bank historic CEM I reference is 866 kg CO2e/t cement; more recent Indonesian sector reporting cites 566 kg/t cement equivalent for Scope 1+2 in 2025, showing factor variability by system boundary.
